info.name: CourseCore API
info.description: Complete operational collection for all 31 runtime endpoints (28 controller actions plus 3 health routes), plus Development-only diagnostics. Bearer authentication defaults to {{accessToken}}; public requests override it with noauth. Import CourseCore Local, fill manual identifiers/credentials, then run folders in numeric order.

exec: if (!baseUrl) { throw new Error("Select CourseCore Local and configure baseUrl before running requests."); }

request.description: Aggregated health check. Public; no policy. Main statuses: 200 when healthy, 503 when unhealthy. In Development the response can include component details.
Minimal liveness check. Public; no policy or input. Expected status: 200.
Readiness check including the database. Public at application level; no policy. Main statuses: 200 or 503 when a dependency is unavailable.

Authenticates the administrative user. Public and rate-limited. Uses adminEmail/adminPassword, stores token.accessToken in accessToken and userId in userId. The refresh token is expected in an HttpOnly cookie managed by the Postman cookie jar. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 429, 500.

exec: pm.test("Login returned an access token", function () { pm.expect(json.token && json.token.accessToken).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });

request.description: Optional login for negative authorization and student flows. Public and rate-limited. Uses studentEmail/studentPassword and stores the JWT separately in studentAccessToken. It also refreshes the HttpOnly cookie in the cookie jar. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 429, 500.

Self-registers a new account with no roles, then authenticates it in the same call. Public and rate-limited. Requires a valid Turnstile response in captchaToken (bypassed automatically outside Production when Turnstile:SecretKey is not configured). The account starts with an unverified e-mail; course content stays locked until Confirm Email succeeds, even for free courses. Response: AuthResponse. Main statuses: 201, 400, 409, 429, 500. Saves userId and accessToken.

exec: pm.test("Registered user has no roles", function () { pm.expect(json.roles).to.be.an("array").that.is.empty; });

request.description: Confirms the authenticated account e-mail using the token that Resend delivered by e-mail after Register (or Resend Confirmation). Bearer required. In local/dev, check application logs when Resend:ApiKey is not configured, since delivery is skipped outside Production. Response: no content. Main statuses: 204, 400, 401, 500.

Invalidates any previous confirmation token for the authenticated account and sends a new one. Bearer required and rate-limited. Returns 409 if the e-mail is already confirmed. Response: no content. Main statuses: 204, 401, 404, 409, 429, 500.

exec: pm.test("Status code is successful or already confirmed", function () {

request.description: Rotates the refresh token using the HttpOnly cookie in the Postman cookie jar and updates accessToken from token.accessToken. Public and rate-limited. The empty body field is only the request contract fallback and no refresh token is stored in the environment. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 429, 500.

Lists users with pagination. Bearer required; policy ManageUsers (users.manage or Admin). Query: page >= 1 and pageSize 1..100. Response: PagedResponse<UserResponse>. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 500. Saves the first returned id in targetUserId when available.

exec: pm.test("Response has pagination metadata", function () { pm.expect(json).to.have.all.keys("items", "page", "pageSize", "totalItems", "totalPages"); });

request.description: Creates a user. Bearer required; policy ManageUsers (users.manage or Admin). Uses uniqueEmail generated immediately before the request. Body: name, email, password. Response: UserResponse. Main statuses: 201, 400, 401, 403, 409, 500. Saves id to targetUserId.
Updates name, email and active state for targetUserId. Bearer required; policy ManageUsers. Path: targetUserId. Response: UserResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500.

Creates or updates direct area access for targetUserId. Bearer required; policy ManageUserAreaAccess (users.manage or Admin). Uses targetUserId and areaId. Response: AreaAccessResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 500.

Creates or updates role area access. Bearer required; policy ManageRoleAreaAccess (roles.manage or Admin). Uses roleId and areaId. Response: AreaAccessResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 500.
Checks the authenticated user access to courseId. Bearer required; policy CheckOwnCourseAccess (authenticated user). Path: courseId. Response: CourseAccessResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

Checks targetUserId access to courseId. Bearer required; policy CheckUserCourseAccess (users.manage, areas.manage, courses.manage, or Admin). Paths: targetUserId, courseId. Response: CourseAccessResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 500.

item.name: 03 - Areas

request.description: Lists areas, optionally filtered by active state via ?active=true|false. Bearer required; policy ManageAreas (areas.manage or Admin). Response: AreaResponse array. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 500. Saves the first returned id in areaId when available.

exec: pm.test("Response is an array", function () { pm.expect(json).to.be.an("array"); });

request.description: Returns areaId details. Bearer required; policy ManageAreas (areas.manage or Admin). Path: areaId. Response: AreaResponse. Main statuses: 200, 401, 403, 404, 500.

Creates an area. Bearer required; policy ManageAreas (areas.manage or Admin). Uses uniqueAreaSlug generated immediately before the request. Body: name, slug, description, displayOrder. Response: AreaResponse. Main statuses: 201, 400, 401, 403, 409, 500. Saves id to areaId.

Updates name, slug, description, display order and active state for areaId. Bearer required; policy ManageAreas. Path: areaId; uses uniqueAreaSlug. Response: AreaResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500.

item.description: Administrative CRUD for the Area catalog under /api/areas. Policy ManageAreas (areas.manage or Admin). Separate from 03 - Access, which owns grants and course-access checks.

request.description: Creates a course and optional nested modules/lessons. Bearer required; policy ManageCourses (courses.manage or Admin). Uses areaId and generates uniqueCourseSlug. Response: CourseResponse. Main statuses: 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500. Saves courseId and courseSlug.
Updates courseId. Bearer required; policy ManageCourses. Path: courseId; uses areaId and uniqueCourseSlug. Response: CourseResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500.
Publishes courseId. Bearer required; policy ManageCourses. Path: courseId; no body. Response: CourseResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 500.

Lists published courses accessible to the authenticated user. Bearer required; no named policy beyond authentication. Response: CourseListItemResponse array. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 500. Saves the first course id/slug when present.

Returns course details and nested modules/lessons for courseId when the authenticated user has access. Bearer required. Path: courseId. Response: CourseDetailsResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 500. Saves courseId, courseSlug, moduleId and lessonId when available.

Creates video metadata for lessonId. Bearer required; policy ManageVideos (videos.manage or Admin). Uses videoStorageKey. Response: VideoResponse. Main statuses: 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500. Saves videoId.
Marks videoId ready. Bearer required; policy ManageVideos. Path: videoId; no body. Response: VideoResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500.

Requests a temporary signed playback URL for videoId. Bearer required; no named policy beyond authentication and course access. Response: VideoPlaybackResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500. The signed URL is deliberately not persisted. Response is Cache-Control: no-store.

exec: pm.test("Playback response has URL and expiration", function () { pm.expect(json.playbackUrl).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; pm.expect(json.expiresAt).to.exist; });

request.description: Registers watchedSeconds for lessonId for the authenticated user. Bearer required; no named policy. Completion is calculated server-side; markAsCompleted is legacy input and is not needed. Response: LessonProgressResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 500. Saves progressId.

Returns the authenticated user progress for courseId. Bearer required; no named policy. Path: courseId. Response: CourseProgressResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 500. Saves progressId and the first lesson progress id when available. Response is Cache-Control: no-store.

item.name: 90 - Deprecated

request.description: DEPRECATED compatibility endpoint. Bearer required; policy CheckOwnCourseAccess. It always uses the authenticated user and accepts courseId in the body. Prefer GET /api/access/courses/{courseId}. Response: CourseAccessResponse. Main statuses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 500.

item.description: Endpoints marked Obsolete in the API. Keep only for compatibility testing; prefer the replacement described on each request.

item.name: 95 - Negative Scenarios

request.description: Negative authentication scenario. Public and rate-limited. Uses a syntactically valid but nonexistent account and expects 401. Do not loop this request to probe rate limits.
Negative validation scenario for the ManageUsers endpoint. Expects 400 because the password violates the server policy.
Negative pagination validation for ManageUsers. Expects 400 for page/pageSize outside accepted limits.
Negative ManageCourses validation. Expects 400 for blank required strings and an empty area list. This is a stable payload validation check, not a 1 MiB stress test.
Negative authorization scenario. Uses studentAccessToken explicitly and expects 403 when the student lacks CheckUserCourseAccess permissions. Requires Login Student and valid targetUserId/courseId.
Negative ManageVideos validation. Expects 400 for an invalid traversal-like storage key. Requires a valid lessonId so storageKey remains the failing field.
Negative progress validation. Expects 400 for negative watchedSeconds. Requires a syntactically valid lessonId.

Negative ManageAreas validation. Reuses uniqueAreaSlug left set by 03 - Areas (Create Area or Update Area) and expects 409 because that slug is already persisted. Run the 03 - Areas folder first in the same session.

item.description: Manual negative scenarios. Run individually after preparing any noted data; no aggressive rate-limit loop is included.

request.description: Revokes the refresh token represented by the HttpOnly cookie in the Postman cookie jar, deletes that cookie server-side and clears accessToken/studentAccessToken locally after success. Public and rate-limited. Main statuses: 204, 429, 500.
OpenAPI document exposed only in Development. Public; no policy. Expected status: 200 when enabled, otherwise 404.

exec: pm.test("Development endpoint is available or hidden", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]); });

request.description: Scalar API reference exposed only in Development. Public; no policy. Expected status: 200/3xx when enabled, otherwise 404.

exec: pm.test("Scalar is available, redirects, or is hidden", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 301, 302, 307, 308, 404]); });
